capabilities: sync a vault with a GitHub repository on desktop and mobile
merge edits from different devices line by line
resolve sync conflicts via git conflict markers or a one-tap command
choose merge, vault-overwrites-repo, or repo-overwrites-vault on first sync
run git in an existing clone of the repository on desktop
extras: GitHub-only for now; files over 100 MB are not synced; token is stored in Obsidian's keychain and never synced; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Turn the Git plugin off on devices that use Easy Git Sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through git, and existing git workflows need a separate git app that phones lack.

relations.evidence: Turn the Git plugin off on devices that use Easy Git Sync.

summary: Git-based vault sync that pushes and merges an Obsidian vault with a GitHub repository on desktop and mobile, without needing git installed.
